PrivacyPreferences.title: PrivacyPreferences
PrivacyPreferences.description: User-selected privacy and data sharing controls chosen during onboarding or in Privacy center.

shareCheckIns.description: Whether mood check-ins and EPDS scores may be shared.

shareAppointments.description: Whether appointment details may be shared.

shareWithOB.description: Whether OB or midwife may view consented data.

shareWithTherapist.description: Whether therapist may view consented data.

shareWithPartner.description: Whether partner may view consented data.

anonymousInCommunity.description: Whether community replies and posts default to anonymous.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Mother's onboarding choices, baby milestone date, focus goals, and privacy center preferences.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

babyDateInput.description: Baby birthday or due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

babyDateLabel.description: Formatted display label for baby age or due date.

selectedGoals.description: Up to 2 selected postpartum support goals.

privacy.description: Privacy center preferences selected at signup or updated later.

niaInsights.description: Up to 6 short non-medical personal preferences and context notes Nia has learned during conversations.

UserPrivateAccount.title: UserPrivateAccount
UserPrivateAccount.description: Isolated PII record storing the authenticated user's email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only onboarding profile, goals, and Privacy Center settings.

/users/{userId}/private/account.description: Isolated owner-only PII subdocument holding account email.
